what: On receiving fx:close, six aperture blades rotate and tighten shut inside a 20vmax circle at screen center — the hexagonal hole radius goes 190 → 28.5 (on a 400 panel), shrinking 7.5% of the remaining distance each frame (about 1.4s, slowing at the end) while the whole panel shrinks 1.15 → .7×. The blades have a coarse grain texture. .1s after fully closed it fires fx:closed — a shutter cut used after opening a photo, before moving to the next page.

options.from · to: Opening amount start·end, default 1 · .15 (hole radius = 190 × value)
options.hold: ms until fx:closed after everything has closed, default 100
options.[data-fx-part=blades]: svg for drawing the wings <g> (inside viewBox 0 0 400 400, with a circle clipPath applied)
options.fx:close · fx:reset: Close start · hide while still open (the caller fires it at the element)

note: The wing shape is redrawn as six straight lines tangent to the circle (same color, so no seam shows where they overlap). The original plays a shutter sound (mp3) at volume .1 after .3s. The sound file is not included

from.where: index.html .pi-shutter (pressing a photo card grows it for 2s, then the shutter closes and it goes to the next page)
